Problem Statement:
Title: Memory Efficient Graph Operations using Dynamic Memory Allocation
You are tasked with creating a memory-efficient program to process and manage a graph in C using dynamic memory allocation. The program should allow you to store and manipulate an undirected graph represented by n nodes and m edges, and later release the allocated memory using free() when operations are complete.
Given a list of edges, your task is to:
Store the edges in an adjacency list.
Counting the number of the connected components that are in the graph.
input_spec:
The first line contains two integers n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) and m (1 ≤ m ≤ 2 * 10^5), representing the number of nodes and the number of edges.
The next m lines contain two integers u and v (1 ≤ u, v ≤ n), indicating that there is an edge between node u and node v.
output_spec: Output a single integer, the number of connected components in the graph.
